outcome: Give Consulting / SI teams a working Voice-of-Customer & Sentiment Analytics Hub capability on their own data — it shortens implementation cycles.
overview: Customers say why they are leaving long before they leave, in call recordings, survey free text and social posts that nobody reads together. This hub pulls those channels into one place, transcribes voice, extracts sentiment, entities and themes, and ranks the drivers behind a falling experience score rather than the symptoms. Arabic and dialect coverage is validated on the client’s own feedback rather than assumed. The analysis is advisory: it points customer-experience teams at causes, it does not act on customers. A four-week build on two live feedback channels gives a Gulf consulting firm a packaged retention offer it can redeploy across retail, telecom and healthcare accounts.
